description: Read the Agent Observatory's hash-chained Manifest Transparency Log: which published manifests changed, before/after hashes, neutral change facts and receipts. Optional `target_id`, `since` (RFC 3339), `limit` (max 100). Free, read-only, no account. Inputs must be public and non-personal; calling declares that (data_classification defaults to PUBLIC).
name: gaip_manifest_changes
